title: Orbitarium — a little space to explore
description: An original, scene-first 3D solar-system toy with procedurally textured planets, Saturn rings, luminous Sun, orbital paths, a responsive eight-planet field guide, selection markers, orbit and zoom camera controls, pause/resume, speed adjustment, selected-planet camera tracking, reset, reduced-motion initialization, and a labelled WebGL fallback.

tests.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {build} from 'vite'; const r=await build({root:'experiments/planetary/astra-medium-detailed',configFile:false,logLevel:'warn',build:{write:false}}); console.log('Vite bundle check passed; '+r.output.length+' outputs generated in memory.');"
tests.outcome: Passed; exit code 0; Vite generated 3 outputs in memory with write:false.

knownLimitations: No browser or visual runtime checks were performed because browser localhost access is unavailable.
Planet sizes, orbit spacing, relative orbital speeds, surface patterns, and lighting are intentionally stylized and labelled as such.
Reference facts are rounded, not a precision ephemeris.
The scene requires WebGL; when unavailable the readable planet guide remains accessible with a labelled explanation and disabled 3D controls.
